digest.component_or_area: ticket store concurrency and event reconvergence
propositions: A description edit verified at 14,997 characters was silently reverted to a 10,582-character older revision without error or conflict exception while the same ticket's plan-review was in flight.
Optimistic concurrency protection (ConcurrencyError/exit 10) did not fire on the losing write; the write reported success, passed read-back verification, and was then silently rolled back afterwards.
A concurrent write that will be discarded currently reports success rather than failing loudly with ConcurrencyError/exit 10.

The interaction between in-flight plan-review sidecar events and concurrent ticket edits either needs deterministic reproduction or the true trigger identified to distinguish between reducer cache races, stale whole-field overwrites, and inbound reconvergence mechanisms.
